pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In which faith is the Rijubalika river important? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Islam
   C. Jainism
   D. Christianity

2. Which Jain teacher is linked with the bank of the Rijubalika river? (1 mark)
   A. Valmiki
   B. Prahlad
   C. Lord Mahavir
   D. Guru Nanak

3. Which is a good way to collect free water for the home? (1 mark)
   A. Taking water from a neighbour
   B. Buying bottled water only
   C. Digging a hole in the road
   D. Collecting rainwater from a roof

4. Which tree is linked with Lord Mahavir's enlightenment? (1 mark)
   A. Ber tree
   B. Tulsi
   C. Banana tree
   D. Sal tree

5. In the seed activity, what happens to the seeds that get no water? (1 mark)
   A. They grow tall fast
   B. They turn into stones
   C. They do not grow
   D. They turn blue

6. What is Ganga jal? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A book
   C. A kind of tree
   D. Water from the River Ganga

7. Which Enlightened Being is a Sikh Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Buddha
   B. Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   C. Parshvanath
   D. Narsimha

8. What do all four Enlightened Beings in the lesson teach in common? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Pride
   C. Selfishness
   D. Kindness, truth and service

9. Narsimha is an Avtar of which god? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Buddha
   B. Lord Vishnu
   C. Lord Ganesh
   D. Lord Shiva

10. What is a kaand in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A river
   C. A section or book of the Ramayan
   D. A festival

11. What is a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. A type of food
   B. A kind of festival
   C. A holy book with teachings
   D. A musical instrument

12. What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures? (1 mark)
   A. A veena and a book
   B. A sword and a shield
   C. A drum and a flag
   D. A bow and arrow

13. How can children with speech difficulties join prayers at assembly? (1 mark)
   A. By leaving
   B. They must not attend
   C. By shouting
   D. By humming or listening

14. Which is a sign of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping your promises
   B. Telling lies
   C. Taking a friend's pen
   D. Cheating in a test

15. Where should the hands be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. On the floor in front
   B. In the air
   C. Behind the head
   D. On the thighs

16. Why should Kapaal Bhaati and Bhastrika be done gently by children? (1 mark)
   A. They are very slow
   B. They cannot be done
   C. They are active and need care
   D. They are painful always

17. Which is one of the four Purusharthas? (1 mark)
   A. Namaste
   B. Moksha
   C. Aarti
   D. Bhajan

18. What does the Shibi story teach? (1 mark)
   A. Kings do not care
   B. A kind person protects the weak
   C. Doves are bad
   D. Hawks always win

19. What is the abhishek? (1 mark)
   A. Lighting a bonfire
   B. Bathing the Shiva Linga with water and milk
   C. Reading a book
   D. Ringing a bell

20. In which month of the Indian traditional calendar is Maha Shivratri celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. Bhadrapada
   B. Kartika
   C. Phalguna
   D. Chaitra

21. What do Jains say on the last day of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Micchami Dukkadam
   B. Namaste
   C. Om Namah Shivaya
   D. Sat Sri Akal

22. On which date did Kenya become fully independent? (1 mark)
   A. 12 December 1963
   B. 1 June 1963
   C. 21 June 2015
   D. 1 January 1964

23. What does Madaraka Day teach? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Greed
   C. Patriotism and unity
   D. Cruelty

24. Maha Shivratri is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Jainism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Hinduism

25. What is Madaraka Day? (1 mark)
   A. A sports day
   B. A Kenyan national holiday on 1 June
   C. A Hindu festival
   D. A Jain festival

26. What is the Indian name for Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. Ravivaar
   B. Mangalvaar
   C. Somvaar
   D. Shanivaar

27. Which planet is called the red planet? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Saturn
   C. Mars
   D. Jupiter

28. What is the Sun in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. A comet
   B. A planet
   C. A moon
   D. A star

29. How many months are in the Indian traditional calendar year? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Seven
   C. Twelve
   D. Fifteen

30. Which day is linked with Venus? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Friday
   C. Monday
   D. Wednesday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Why is water sometimes used in worship? Give three points. (3 marks)

32. Explain why the Indian traditional calendar is special and how a child can use it. (5 marks)

33. Write three ways in which a child can practise Prani Daya. (3 marks)

34. Choose one scripture and explain how a child can apply its teaching at home and at school. (5 marks)

35. Explain how learners can include friends with special needs in yoga. (5 marks)

36. Match each element to its Sanskrit name: earth, fire, air. (3 marks)

37. Describe how the Bodhi tree is linked with the Buddha. (3 marks)

38. Explain how the four faiths in this lesson teach integrity. (5 marks)

39. Name two trees or plants that are sacred in different faiths. (2 marks)

40. Explain how a maize farm uses all five elements. (4 marks)

41. Name any four of the five great elements of the Panch Mahabhoot. (2 marks)

42. Name the two Ramayan kaands studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

43. State what the Gayatri Mantra asks God to give us. (2 marks)

44. Explain how you would present a short skit on one Enlightened Being. (4 marks)

45. List the five principles of Dharma studied in the lesson. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Jainism
   Jains believe Lord Mahavir became enlightened on its bank.

2. C — Lord Mahavir
   Lord Mahavir is believed to have become fully enlightened there.

3. D — Collecting rainwater from a roof
   Roof water can be stored in a tank or jerrican.

4. D — Sal tree
   Jains say Lord Mahavir became enlightened under a sal tree.

5. C — They do not grow
   Seeds need water to sprout.

6. D — Water from the River Ganga
   Jal means water, so Ganga jal is water from the Ganga.

7. B — Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   He was the fourth Guru of the Sikhs.

8. D — Kindness, truth and service
   Their teachings are alike in these values.

9. B — Lord Vishnu
   Narsimha is one of Lord Vishnu's Avtars.

10. C — A section or book of the Ramayan
   The Ramayan is divided into kaands.

11. C — A holy book with teachings
   Scriptures hold the wisdom of great teachers.

12. A — A veena and a book
   The veena and the book.

13. D — By humming or listening
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

14. A — Keeping your promises
   Keeping promises shows honesty.

15. D — On the thighs
   Palms on the thighs.

16. C — They are active and need care
   They are active exercises.

17. B — Moksha
   The four are Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha.

18. B — A kind person protects the weak
   Kindness protects the weak.

19. B — Bathing the Shiva Linga with water and milk
   Abhishek is ritual bathing of the murti or symbol.

20. C — Phalguna
   Phalguna, in February or March.

21. A — Micchami Dukkadam
   It asks for forgiveness.

22. A — 12 December 1963
   Jamhuri Day is 12 December.

23. C — Patriotism and unity
   It teaches love for country.

24. D — Hinduism
   It is a Hindu festival.

25. B — A Kenyan national holiday on 1 June
   It celebrates self-government.

26. A — Ravivaar
   Ravi is the Sun.

27. C — Mars
   Mars is the red planet.

28. D — A star
   The Sun is a star.

29. C — Twelve
   It has twelve months.

30. B — Friday
   Shukravaar.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: It cleans, so it is a sign of purity; it is used to wash the hands and feet before prayer; it is poured or sprinkled to show a place is clean and ready.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: It links daily life to the sky and seasons, keeps tradition alive and fixes festival dates. A child can make a weekly plan, a decorated calendar, greeting cards or a song.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for why it is special and 3 marks for uses.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give water to thirsty animals, share food, help a hurt friend, do not harm insects, care for plants (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct scripture with a clear lesson and two examples, for example Ramayan: keep promises at home by helping with chores and at school by returning a book on time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for scripture, 1 mark for lesson, 1 mark each for home and school examples, 1 mark for clarity.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: They can do breathing slowly, take seated poses, help hold the chart or take photos, and be encouraged by their partners. Everyone's effort is respected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points and 1 mark for respect.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Earth: Prithvi. Fire: Agni. Air: Vayu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prince Siddhartha sat under a Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya and became the Buddha, the Awakened One. Buddhists honour the tree because of this.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the tree, 1 mark for Siddhartha, 1 mark for enlightenment or Bodh Gaya.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hinduism: truth (Harishchandra). Sikhism: honest earnings (Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo). Jainism: not stealing (Asteya). Buddhism: right speech and not stealing or lying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each faith and 1 mark for a summary.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tulsi, Ber (Beri) tree, Bodhi tree, Sal tree (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plant.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: The soil is Prithvi, rain and river water are Jal, the sun's heat is Agni, the wind that carries pollen is Vayu, and the open sky is Akash.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each element linked correctly to the farm, up to 4.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any four of: Prithvi (earth), Jal (water), Agni (fire), Vayu (air), Akash (space).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each correct element, up to 2 marks.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Bal Kaand and Ayodhya Kaand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: That the divine light guide our minds toward what is good and true (wisdom).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for wisdom or guidance of the mind.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a story, decide the characters, practise the lines, act it out, and then say what lesson it teaches.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for choosing the story, roles, practice, acting and lesson (any four).

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Paramatma, Purushartha, Prani Daya, Punarjanam, Prarthana (any correct set earns marks).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each, rounded up.
